releaseNotes: Created an independent adaptive Chrome PWA for phone and computer; the original Chrome Android, iOS and Computer deliveries remain separate.
Smart Review now lets students select multiple topics and set a separate question count for each selected topic; the Smart Pick is optional and can be hidden.
Added English (US), English (UK) and Arabic question-reading voice selection; English (US) is the default.
Exam Goal Planner now accepts custom exam names and multiple separate exam dates.

Study Timer presents a countdown using the configured focus duration, with browser notification and sound alerts when the page is running; browser alarms cannot be guaranteed after the browser or device fully closes the app.
The existing 1,718-question bank and its explanations are preserved unchanged.
Pediatrics now opens a separate choice between Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Joaki MCQ and Previous Questions; each collection has its own medical systems and topics.
Previous Questions reuses the existing SHBACE medical-system and topic artwork. Question wording, IDs, answer keys and explanations remain unchanged.
Pediatrics collection artwork is reduced to 256px WebP and embedded in the page; circular CSS clipping hides square corners, with AJ/FM initials as load fallbacks.
Long MCQ stems use safer word wrapping without changing the original question text.
